description: Reverse-ETL sink: batch-upsert rows from an upstream DataFrame into Confluence Cloud pages, one row per page, matched on (space_id, title). Confluence has no native page upsert endpoint -- this is a search-then-write pattern (GET by space-id+title, then PUT or POST), with version-number-plus-one handled automatically on update.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row upserts one Confluence page, matched on (space_id, title).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Confluence.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

space_id.label: Space Id
space_id.description: Confluence space id to scope pages to (numeric space id, not the space key).

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Confluence field name. Must include exactly one mapping to 'title'.

body_column.label: Body Column
body_column.description: Upstream column holding the page's body content.

wrap_body_as_html.label: Wrap Body As Html
wrap_body_as_html.description:
If true, body_column is treated as plain text and wrapped into escaped

paragraphs. If false, body_column is assumed to already be storage-format XHTML.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Confluence Page Upsert
